title: Phase 2 Second Review & v10.0 Protocol Re-Audit — Public Marketing, Secondary Pages & Funnels (Re-evaluating DIR-003, DIR-005, DIR-006)
spec:
# Phase 2 Second Review Directive: Public Marketing, Secondary Pages & Funnels (DIR-031)
**Governing Protocol:** SKILL.md v10.0 (AI Bridge Supervisor Master Edition)
**Execution Schedule:** Sequenced in the Post-DIR-028 Second Review Pipeline.
**Target Directives for Re-Audit:** DIR-003, DIR-005, DIR-006.

## 1. Objective & Scope
Re-evaluate Public Marketing surfaces, guest-to-candidate conversion funnels, and secondary pages against v10.0 protocol rules.

## 2. Mandatory Verification Gates
1. **§10 Legacy Dashboard2 Purge:** Confirm zero orphaned imports or lingering files.
2. **§21.1 Token Grounding:** Full tokenization of Marketing landing page, pricing tables, and footer.
3. **§65 Conversion Funnel:** Level 5 Playwright validation of entire guest signup and onboarding flow.
4. **§22 WCAG 2.2 AA Contrast:** All text passes >= 4.5:1 contrast standards.
invariants: INV-1: Zero legacy Dashboard2 imports: Entire repository must use src/components/Marketing/LandingPage.jsx and semantic marketing elements.
INV-2: Authentic pricing & currency: All marketing pricing tables must display correct INR ₹ symbols and active subscription tiers.
acceptanceCriteria: §10 Legacy Residue Purge Verification: AST import audit confirming zero direct dependencies on deprecated Dashboard2 paths.
§21.1 Marketing Landing Page & Secondary Pages Token Audit: Landing page hero, feature grids, pricing tiers, FAQs, and footer match Cuba executive glassmorphism with 0 legacy utility residue.

§65 End-to-End Guest-to-Candidate Conversion Funnel: Level 5 Playwright test validating guest visitor -> pricing tier selection -> registration/login -> candidate onboarding funnel with zero 404s or broken CTAs.
§22 WCAG 2.2 AA Contrast on all marketing typography and testimonial cards.
